en.headline: Lawmakers press childcare and North District shops in debate
en.dek: The third day of the joint five-year plan and Policy Address debate turned to livelihood, with calls on childcare and vacant shops.
body: Lawmakers spent Friday morning on the livelihood session of a joint debate on Hong Kong's first five-year plan and the Policy Address, the third day of the motion debate.

Election Committee member Chan Man-ki said she had long pressed for better childcare across the city, and welcomed plans for standalone child-care centres and after-school care in schools. She said extra places mattered, but siting should match demand, using census data and locations near workplaces and transport interchanges. She also said the government should study a failure-to-protect offence covering both children and elderly people, and a mandatory reporting system for older residents.

New Territories North member Jeff Yiu Ming said Sheung Shui and the wider North District had been shaped by parallel-trading shops and pharmacies, and that residents had noticed pharmacies leaving as spending patterns changed. He said the district needed a different mix as the Northern Metropolis took shape.

Yiu suggested the government lead efforts to use vacant shops for local food businesses, cultural and creative work, or weekend markets, so the old parallel-trading streets could become ordinary shopping streets. He said that could serve residents and draw visitors from other districts. The remarks were made in the Legislative Council debate and are not government policy.

zh.headline: 立法會辯論民生 陳曼琪倡一老一小保護 姚銘談北區舖位
zh.dek: 五年規劃與施政報告合併辯論第三日轉到民生環節，議員談託兒名額、虐老舉報及北區空舖。
body: 立法會周五上午進入香港首個五年規劃及施政報告合併辯論的第三日，本節議題是切實提升民生福祉、完善民生保障體系。
選委界議員陳曼琪表示，她一直爭取完善全港託兒服務，樂見政府增設獨立幼兒中心及在校課後託管。她說名額增加重要，但選址應配合需求，建議結合人口普查數據，把服務點放近工作地點及公共交通交匯處。她又說虐兒個案一宗都嫌多，虐老風險亦不能忽視，建議政府研究涵蓋一老一小的「沒有保護罪」，並為長者設立類似的強制舉報機制。
新界北議員姚銘說，北區尤其上水一帶以往多是水貨客相關商舖和藥房；隨着兩地消費模式改變，藥房陸續退場，區內居民樂見社區不再那麼擠迫混亂，民生商舖比例較以往多。他認為隨着北部都會區發展，北區經濟需要轉型。
姚銘建議政府牽頭善用空置商舖，引入本地特色飲食、文創，或舉辦周末特色市集，把昔日水貨街轉成民生步行街，既方便街坊，也可吸引其他區市民前來。有關發言是立法會辯論中的建議，並非已落實的政府政策。
